mines.mine_notes: Open pit + underground (Golouma UG, Kerekounda UG); 4.3 Mtpa CIL plant + 1.2 Mtpa BIOX plant commissioned mid-2024 for high-grade refractory ore. 5,530 kt milled @ 1.93 g/t, 80.4% recovery. Non-controlling interest 10%.
mines.processing: CIL + BIOX (biological oxidation) for refractory ore; 37 MWp solar PV plant

mines.mine_notes: Open pit; CIL plant commissioned 2019 ahead of schedule (was initially a heap leach operation). Longest operating history of any gold mine in Côte d'Ivoire; over 300 koz/yr since 2022. 7,357 kt milled @ 1.51 g/t, 90.4% recovery. NCI 15% (85% owned; Le Plaque area 90%).
Open pit; first gold poured Q2-2024; first full year of operation, ran above nameplate capacity. HPGR crushing circuit. 4,216 kt milled @ 1.47 g/t, 93.4% recovery. NCI 20% (80% owned).

Open pit; commissioned 2017; CIL throughput expanded from 3.8 Mtpa nameplate to over 5 Mtpa. 5,130 kt milled @ 1.79 g/t, 86.2% recovery. NCI increased from 10% to 15% in 2025 (85% owned). Kari Pump / Vindaloo pits.

Transitioned in 2024 to solely underground operation (Siou and Wona deposits). 2,247 kt milled @ 2.85 g/t, 85.9% recovery. NCI increased from 10% to 15% in 2025 (85% owned). Highest-cost mine in portfolio.

Development project (100% owned, subject to change to reflect Côte d'Ivoire State participation per exploitation-phase law). Maiden resources added in 2025 at nearby satellite targets. DFS advanced in 2025. P&P reserve 77.4 Mt @ 1.76 g/t (4,379 koz), optimised at $1,500/oz gold.

notes: All figures from 2025 Annual Report and Accounts (published March 2026). Production is attributable gold produced: 1,208,961 oz rounded to 1,209 koz; group AISC $1,433/oz sold; adjusted EBITDA $2,315.6M; realised gold price ~$3,244/oz (after revenue protection programme; LBMA avg $3,432). Cash costs = total cash costs (TCC)/oz sold. Sabodala-Massawa stream included in realised price. Discontinued operations (Boungou/Wahgnion sold 2023) excluded.
